notes.title: Update Notes - September 15, 2024
notes.content:
New Content
[list]
[*] Tutorial Island - New map dedicated for teaching the ropes
[*] Key Binds - Tired of the old controls? now they can be changed to your liking!
[*] Brightness Slider in settings 
[*] New Widget to notify game saves 
[*] New Main Menu Message replacing the Welcome Letter
[/list]

Fixes/Changes
[list]
[*] Walls and Door Frames have been remodelled to be 2-sided
[*] Map Icons adjusted
[*] Builds being deleted will change white during the process
[*] Fixed an issue preventing staircases from being deleted 
[*] Create World Menu remodelled 
[*] Beach and Snow Edge maps expanded 
[/list]

notes.title: Update - August 13, 2024
notes.content:
Thank you for the patience while we worked on this long but needed update. With it we bring new features for players to enjoy.

New Content
[list]
[*] Navigational Map and a Mini map.
[*] 2 New maps; Beach Map, and a Snowy Mountain edge
[/list]

Fixes/Changes
[list]
[*] (Temp) Brighten the map light, looking into allowing the player to adjust this through settings
[*] Lowered gift chest pay outs.
[*] Relocated build area on the Original map (Mountain - Large)
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes - March 25, 2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Second Floor Stairs rescaled to line with floors
[*] Second floor Stairs no longer interfere with wall placements 
[*] Removed floor snap on stairs. (Caused floors to not align with walls)
[*] Lighting status added to save/load. Lights will save when turned on/off and reload from their saved status
[*] Removed Owned limit check when picking up buildables. (Stopped the player from picking up placed buildables)
[*] Carpet Collsion resized. (Able to be destroyed/picked up now) 
[*] Carpets resized appropriately to foundations
[*] Bookcases resized to fit 1 wall rooms
[*] Bookcases and Shelves have New decoration snap points. Fill that empty shelf space with a new decoration!
[*] 40+ New Buildables - New decorations add to general store!
[*] New interactables; Furnace and Washbowls
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes - February 20, 2024
notes.content:

New Features

[*] Town Relationships
[*] Loans
[*] Tavern Score
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Foundation overlapping
[*] Roof Snaps
[*] Serve Item List updating
[/list]
